This record was written by the Desk in the tool's schema (831.timestamp.record.v1) because the tool's stamp path could not complete through its own transport; every value above is recomputed from the artifacts on file.

The tsa field above omits the certificate subject's emailAddress component by design: publication_hygiene.py H4 refuses an address in any record; the address itself is public (it is the timestamp service's own contact, printed in its TSA certificate) and is carried only in freetsa.tsr under the scan's allowance.
